column1: # tests/ci/cloud_kinds.tsv -- the DECLARED kinds of a cloud run ([CLOUD-SUITE] B, requirement 7). ONE table, read by
# the workflow's plan job, scripts/cloudrun and tests/ci/cloud_gather.sh through tests/ci/cloud_kinds.sh; no
# code names a kind (tests/ci/cloud_check.sh holds that). A new kind is a new row.
# Columns (TAB-separated):
#   kind        the KIND in the branch cloud/OWNER/KIND/NAME
#   command     what one shard runs; {shard} = K/N, {selector} = the selector column
#   selector    what picks a shard's work (for test: the declared shard table; `-` = none)
#   shards      N, or `table` = the `# shards=N` line of the selector file
#   max_parallel  shards that run at once (a shard count above it queues in waves)
#   limit_min   per-shard step limit in minutes (a shard past it is RED by name, never green)
#   needs       setup the shard needs: `pcre2` = the pinned libpcre2 10.46 build; `-` = none. shard-setup provides exactly this set today
#               (cloud_check.sh refuses a value it cannot provide)
#   owners      who may start it: `*` = any owner, else a comma list
#   population  a command (run from the repo root by tests/ci/cloud_check.sh) that COUNTS the selector's population: every unit of
#               the unsplit run in exactly one shard. {selector} = the selector column; {sections} = TEST_SECTIONS (argv of cloud_check)
#   measured    the COMMITTED measured-times file of the kind (tests/ci/cloud_measure.py writes it: median seconds per unit over
#               recent completed runs; tests/ci/cloud_reweight.sh reads it). Kinds sharing a selector table are averaged into it
#   reweight_margin  percent: the slowest shard's wall past the table's `# predicted_shard_s=` by more than this puts a
#               REWEIGHT-DUE line in the verdict (cloud_gather.sh). UNMEASURED default 25 -- no run has shown the natural spread
#   reweigh     the command that regenerates the selector table from the measured file(s) (tests/ci/cloud_reweight.sh runs it
#               from the repo root): {measured} = the measured files of every kind sharing this selector, {setup_s},
#               {max_parallel}, {write} = `--write` (empty on --dry)
#   setup_s     seconds a shard spends before its command (checkout, python, libpcre2, build): the plan's per-shard fixed cost.
#               UNMEASURED default 70 (cloud_plan.py's); the job log's step times would measure it
#   suite       1 = scripts/cloudrun --suite dispatches this kind (one commit, every such kind: the cloud full suite); 0 = on request only
kind
test
axes
ubsan
asan
mech
recidentity
